Callout.Name: SWAT Raid
Callout.Message: Raid authorised on an address, occupants refusing to come out.
Callout.Advisory: Two inside, weapons believed present, entry team waiting on your call.

Script.Line: They are not answering and the door is barricaded from the inside.
Nobody goes through that door until you say the word.

Lines.Approach: They will not come out and the entry team is waiting on you. Two inside, and they are armed.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
